questions.stem: Which factors does gravitational potential energy depend on?

options.text: Mass, height, and gravitational field strength
Mass and gravitational field strength only

questions.explanation: Gravitational potential energy depends on mass (m), height (h), and gravitational field strength (g). The equation is GPE = mgh.

questions.stem: What is the GPE of a 3 kg object held 5 m above the ground? (g = 10 N/kg)
